description:
Give your floor size (dimensions, square feet or a garage-size preset), the coating type (water-based epoxy, 100% solids, polyaspartic or 1-part paint) and coats, and get the gallons and kit count including porosity allowance and clear topcoat, pounds of decorative flake at full, medium or light broadcast, a DIY-materials versus professional-install cost range, and a prep and cure plan that says plainly when conditions (slab temperature, humidity, new concrete, failed moisture test, old peeling coating) mean do not coat today.

Typical requests: how much epoxy do I need for a 2 car garage, garage floor epoxy cost, epoxy vs polyaspartic, how many kits for 500 square feet, how much flake for a garage floor, can I epoxy in cold weather, how long before I can park on epoxy, DIY epoxy floor cost vs professional, epoxy over old epoxy, new concrete epoxy wait time, garage floor coating square footage calculator.

Every result is shown as a card with the numbers, the steps and links to the matching kit, degreaser, etch and tools (physical goods) and to free quotes from local installers through garageresin.com. No account needed.
